name: Start TOTP Enrollment
summary: An authenticated user explicitly starts TOTP enrollment; the server stages authenticator material and the client transitions to the QR/secret enrollment view.

preconditions.expression: user is authenticated and TOTP is not currently enabled

serverInteraction.intent: Begin TOTP enrollment exactly once and return the staged otpauth URI and secret needed by the destination view.

postconditions.expression: TOTP enrollment material is staged but TOTP is not yet enabled

sourceReferences.note: BeginTotpEnrollmentAsync is the single server operation for this scenario.
Real-path server proof exercises AuthenticationFlowService, the typed begin handler and AppUserMfaManager and validates staged material plus auth events.

Server and Angular implementation are complete. React Native still renders a placeholder instead of a locally generated scannable QR code, so implementation remains in-progress until that client gap is closed.
